[P2] Freeze context-held observations before cleanup

When a phase fails before collection and the adapter has no optional `collect_partial`, local `evidence` remains empty even if `context.evidence` already contains observations. Retirement is audited against that empty baseline; the fallback copy happens only after lease release. A retirement snapshot can therefore omit a known task or resource and permit target reuse, while cleanup can overwrite the reported observations. Deep-copy retained context evidence before `release`/`retire` and use that baseline for auditing and reporting. Cover early failure without `collect_partial`.
